shortDescription: Polymarket’s "Chicago Cubs vs. Miami Marlins" submarket for "Spread -1.5" saw the Chicago Cubs option’s implied win probability fall sharply from 68% one hour earlier to 39.5%, a 28.5 percentage-point move. According to ChainCatcher, the sudden swing may reflect the impact of breaking news.
